properties.decision: Anthony, 2026-10-25: "The two dead names (manual_work_report, record_change): drop them in the next reflow2 release." Each was renamed on 2026-09-18 (to manual_work_ledger and snapshot_before_change) and has since only refused and pointed at its new name, saying "removed next release", several releases ago. Neither was called through flo2.io from 2026-09-24 to 2026-10-25. Their refusal has been the deprecating release that reflow2-mcp-stays-as-is asks for, so removing them meets that rule. The release notes name both and their replacements.
